headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: BEA (7)

summary: Lando Norris won the Austrian Grand Prix from pole position, 2.7s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Nico Hulkenberg made the biggest climb, from P20 to P9.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised TSU (10 second time penalty) and COL (5 second time penalty).
There were 32 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 15 points over Lando Norris.
